cases.comparison: Record both status values and candidate diagnostic; signal 15 must yield 143.
cases.oracle: Shell wait status from the same directly executed child and the POSIX signal status convention.
cases.purpose: Verify signal-terminated child status propagates as 128 plus the signal number.
cases.script:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
  mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
[[ $(type -t ns) == builtin ]] || exit 99
ns spawn none /usr/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c 'kill -TERM "$$"' >"$HOME/candidate.out" 2>"$HOME/candidate.err"; rc=$?
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/candidate-status.raw"
printf 'signal-status=%s\n' "$rc"
cases.setup_script:
[[ $UID == "$EUID" && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r marker </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
IFS= read -r vendor </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
[[ $vendor == QEMU && $marker =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
if ((EUID==0)); then
  mapfile -t maps </proc/self/uid_map || exit 125
  (( ${#maps[@]} == 1 )) || exit 125
  read -r a b n tail <<<"${maps[0]}"; [[ $a == 0 && $b == 2000 && $n == 1 && -z $tail ]] || exit 125
else ((EUID==2000)) || exit 125; fi
virt=$(/usr/bin/systemd-detect-virt --vm) || exit 125
[[ $virt == qemu || $virt == kvm ]] || exit 125
if /usr/bin/bash --noprofile --norc -c 'kill -TERM "$$"' >"$HOME/native.out" 2>"$HOME/native.err"; then rc=0; else rc=$?; fi
printf '%s\n' "$rc" >"$HOME/native-status.raw"
[[ $rc == 143 ]] || exit 98
